title: BDB Graph Run State
description: Typed hand-off record for a /startcycle run, replacing free-form production_artifacts/*.md prose as the transport edges evaluate. See .agents/graph.md for the dispatcher loop this state drives. Persisted at production_artifacts/state.json.

run_id.description: Unique id for this /startcycle run, e.g. a timestamp or short hash. Lets a fresh dispatcher invocation resume the right run instead of guessing.

goal.description: The user's original request, verbatim or lightly normalized. Every node reads this instead of re-deriving intent from a prior node's prose (F-17: context fidelity).

phase.description: Current pipeline stage. 'ready_to_ship' means all gates passed but no GO has been recorded yet -- distinct from 'ship' (actively executing the GO-gated push) and 'done'. 'escalated' means the dispatcher stopped the loop and handed control back to the user (max_iterations reached or needs_human).

artifacts.description: Paths to the human-readable markdown artifacts nodes produce. state.json is what edges evaluate; these stay the readable payload.

findings.description: Reviewer output. Each finding is owned by exactly one build node so the dispatcher knows which node to re-invoke on a repair loop.

node.description: Which build node owns fixing this finding.

gate.description: Shipping's quality-gate results. Any 'fail' here, with iteration < max_iterations, is what the Stop hook (.claude/hooks/graph-gate.mjs) blocks on.

iteration.description: Repair-loop counter. Incremented by the dispatcher every time an edge sends the run back to a build node (TechLead rejection, Reviewer findings, or a failed gate).

max_iterations.description: Hard stop on the repair loop, staying well under Claude Code's own 8-consecutive-Stop-hook-block override, so this run's escalation fires deterministically before that platform ceiling would silently end the turn instead. See the dispatcher (.claude/workflows/startcycle-dispatch.mjs) for the no-progress guard that can also escalate before this ceiling is reached: if a repair round reports the exact same blocking finding IDs Reviewer already flagged, the run stops rather than repeating an identical cycle.

approvals.description: GO tokens observed for this run. Distinct from the go-gate.mjs hook's own transcript check -- this is a state-level record of when/where a GO was given, for audit purposes.

needs_human.description: Any node can set this to force an in-loop feedback edge back to the user (per B5's reference diagram), independent of the gate/iteration state.
